scope: Development-only joint phase/additive source-frequency-bias test. Prior chosen from residual-frequency investigation before this geographic comparison. No validation results used to set it.
bias_law: Additive Hz, shared across receiver/channel groups; not an extra RF-dependent slope. Common additive bias is gauge-confounded with receiver offsets; Gaussian prior centers it.
controls: Both c arms have identical observations, original candidate pools, shared non-RF starts, remaining priors and per-position budgets. Restricted/expanded source-bias models use the same requested points.
